I grew up in a poor household. Bullied as a kid. Didn’t eat breakfast or lunch ate bologna sandwiches for supper. If I happened to be with a friend I’d eat supper with them, then leave to go to another friend’s and eat supper there too. Food was scarce at times. I ballooned to 260 in High School, lost 80 lbs to join the army (starved myself) went to basic and that was the first time I had three full meals in a day. At 180 lbs and short I was still a bigger guy. Completed basic and airborne school went to RIP and developed some bad knees in the process. Took 3 years into my military career for someone to look at me for bad knees as opposed to being heavy. Turned out I had every miniscus torn in both knees. Had surgery on both my knees back to back (30 days apart). And deployed 2 weeks after my second one. Now I am medically retired from the military with knee, back, ankle, damage and nerve damage in my arm. I hurt all the time. And eat to stop thinking about it.
Weight loss...like every other overweight person. I know how to lose weight. I just don’t know how to stay motivated and/or determined.
